ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: hold the way in
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Put a gate across the way in that most raids take, with cover behind it; on open ground, wall the home in with one gate. Colony → Defenses shows where.

plain.li: I've walked the ground. Nearly every raid will come the same way in, and that's where we should be waiting for them, behind a gate.
We know where they come from now. A wall across it, one gate, and sandbags behind: let's spend the next fortnight on that.

warm.li: I want everyone to know where to stand when the alarm goes, and to have something to stand behind. Let's build the gate.

blunt.li: They walk in the same way every time. Put a gate in it.

cheerful.li: Picture it: they come round the hill and there's a gate, and behind it, us. I like that picture.

gloomy.li: Every raid so far has had the run of the place. Next time it should have to come through a gate.

cold.li: The ground decides where raids come from. We decide where they stop. A gate, with cover behind it.

plain.li: The gate's up and there's cover behind it. Now we know where the fight will be.

blunt.li: Let them come through the gate. That's what it's for.

gloomy.li: A gate won't stop all of them. It'll stop them all coming at once.

cold.li: The way in is ours now.
